name: A Hunter's Challenge
summary: At Farstrider Lodge, A Hunter's Challenge tests your speed across Loch Modan's rugged highlands. Daryl the Youngling, a brash human, wagers his shirt that you cannot track and kill five elder mountain boars within twelve minutes, against rough ground and dangerous wildlife.

sections.title: A Youth's Boast
sections.body: Daryl the Youngling lives among the seasoned huntsmen of Farstrider Lodge, but he has none of their quiet patience. He makes up for his youth with bluster and tall hunting tales, including rambling stories of how he earned his “famous” scar. Unwilling to admit anyone else is skilled, he continually gets his fellow hunters’ names wrong. He also devises strict trials to humble newcomers and restore his inflated standing among the lodge’s residents.

sections.title: The Highland Hunt
sections.body: The elder mountain boars that roam Loch Modan’s crags and hillsides are massive, thick-skinned, and dangerous when provoked. Daryl gives you twelve minutes to find five, kill them, and confirm each kill. Finish in time, and the loudmouthed youngster retreats awkwardly, pretending he knows nothing of the extravagant wager he made so casually.

faq.answer: Daryl is a young, boastful human huntsman at Farstrider Lodge in southeastern Loch Modan. Desperate to seem as formidable as the older veterans around him, he talks up his prowess, invents grand tales, and challenges passing adventurers to difficult hunts.

faq.q: Where are the elder mountain boars located?
faq.answer: Elder mountain boars roam the foothills, meadows, and ridges around Farstrider Lodge and across southern and eastern Loch Modan. They graze on the high ground between the lodge and the central loch.
Daryl gives you only twelve minutes because he expects you to fail. He hopes the tight deadline will embarrass you and prove your earlier hunting successes were beginner’s luck.
Daryl wagers the shirt off his back if you kill five elder mountain boars in time. When you return victorious, he quickly pretends he cannot remember making the bet.

faq.q: How does this compare to Coldridge Valley boars?
faq.answer: The elder mountain boars of Loch Modan are tougher and more aggressive than the smaller boars novice dwarves hunt in Coldridge Valley. Their hides are thicker, and their tusks are dangerous, honed on highland granite.

faq.q: Where does this hunting chain lead next?
faq.answer: After you finish Daryl’s challenge and silence his boasting, attention at the lodge turns to more serious business: a confrontation with the dangerous elder bear Ol' Sooty in Vyrin's Revenge.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking five elder mountain boars through the highland brush and dispatching them within a strict time limit tests your handling of the quarry.
As a dwarf who came up through Coldridge Valley, you will recognize Daryl’s comparison, though his patronizing manner may be harder to stomach.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Farstrider Lodge as a staging ground for woodsmen guarding Loch Modan’s eastern border from wild beasts and highland threats.
